assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a SINGLE production bitmap prop texture for a Chinese cultivation game, a genuinely handheld ancient formation-disc base. This must look like an ancient scholar-artificer's working instrument, NOT a board game, jewelry or a user-interface frame. Entirely new design.
Subject: ONE perfectly top-down ROUND, low-profile solid disc of dark blue-charcoal xuan stone. Flat broad stone face, subtle natural smoky slate mineral grain over a large surface, softly worn edges, convincing thin physical mass visible only as an understated beveled outer lip. The extremely narrow outer rim has a few segments of aged reddish copper binding, dark rubbed patina and a very few interrupted shallow seal-like scratches. The stone dominates; no shiny gold or pale green gemstone framing. Chinese fine ink drawing and restrained mineral watercolor, tactile practical craftsmanship, low saturation, clear readable silhouette. Soft upper-left lighting within the object only. No cartoon badge, no glossy 3D jewel render.
Critical geometry: SQUARE canvas designed for exact 832 x 832 export. Round disc diameter about 96% of canvas, centered, only about 2% transparent clearance at each side. Reserve the central 512 x 512 region, from (160,160) to (672,672), as a flat unobstructed stone working surface. These coordinates are INVISIBLE production guides, NOT markings to draw. The whole central square INCLUDING ITS FOUR CORNERS must lie fully on the disc and must have NO decoration or structural obstruction. The largest empty working face is intentionally calm with low-contrast broad stone grain so separate small components can be laid anywhere on it. Put every rim binding, seal scratch, chip, copper pin and decorative detail only in the outer round annulus beyond that central square. Never draw a square frame or boundary inside the disc.
True alpha-transparent outside the circular disc. No cast shadow, aura, glow, mist, floor, hands, characters or scene. The stone surface itself must be opaque.
ABSOLUTE EXCLUSIONS: no rectangular picture-frame shape, no grid, no checkerboard, no board-game holes, no chess or go sockets, no tiled panels, no center eye, no mounted components, no wires or premade circuit, no ports, no compass directions or tick marks, no giant yin-yang or magic circle, no readable text, numbers or labels. Exactly one plain ROUND physical formation disc, unclipped, no other object.

Soft upper-left illumination expressed only within the object, legible plain large forms with modest bevels and low-frequency stone grain. Strict orthographic TOP VIEW. Square canvas for 128 x 128 export; component centered with 10-12% transparent breathing room and a readable silhouette.
True alpha-transparent background, clean edge; no paper, scene, hands, floor or outside shadow. No glow, aura, smoke or halo. ABSOLUTELY NO steering wheel, circular three-spoke wheel, compass, eyeball, iris, pupil, central gem, concentric jewelry rings, necklace, mirror face, shield, UI frame, text, glyphs, grid, wire, baked ports, arrows, numbers or dial markings. Exactly one irregular eight-lobed stone stabilizer, no multiple variants.

assets.initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE bitmap physical energy-source component for an ancient Chinese cultivation formation-disc construction game. Entirely new design, not a recolored gemstone battery.
Subject: a single horizontally elongated BOAT-SHAPED partly open ancient reddish-copper return-flow casket. One connected shallow craft mechanism, subtly asymmetrical ends, overall physical silhouette TWO TO ONE wide. Inside the opening is ONE continuous seal of opaque smoky ivory spiritual marrow, cloudlike solid mineral material, not two crystals and not a pool of glowing liquid. A few finely overlapping scale-like old copper plates partially close and protect the opening, leaving the quiet smoke-white substance visible between them. A slightly raised folded copper cover at one end and the layered thin copper construction should explain how it is held and protected. It must read as a working functional ancient instrument rather than jewelry, a decorative sign, a coin, a modern battery or an ornamental gemstone plaque. The copper is aged, dark muted brick red with brown-black patina, NOT gold; no full shiny jewel bezel. No gemstones.
Style: Chinese fine ink linework and restrained mineral watercolor with tactile matte material; smoky charcoal, old reddish copper and clouded off-white chalcedony. Soft upper-left illumination only inside the object, broad legible forms and a clean silhouette. Strict orthographic TOP VIEW, horizontal. True 2:1 image canvas for 256 x 128 export. The complete one-piece object occupies around 82% width and 80% height, leaving transparent margins. Keep the WHOLE physical body about 2:1 rather than an extremely thin 3:1 bar.
True alpha-transparent outside the component. No cast shadow, pedestal, floor, background, scene, hands or scenery. No emitted smoke, light rays, glowing center, halo, aura, labels, letters, Chinese symbols, numbers, grids, wires, baked input/output ports, arrows, gauges or UI frame. Exactly ONE continuous boat-like casket, not two duplicated square pieces and not a sheet of variants.

It is a practical ancient formation mechanism, no gemstones or jewelry.
The current object is a very thin three-to-one bar. REDRAW the same object as a more compact, substantial TWO-TO-ONE wide casket. Increase its body height relative to its length, giving the broad visible cloudy-white marrow channel more depth across the image. The entire physical body including its cover should be about 2:1 width to height. Use a WIDE 2:1 canvas with an even clean transparent margin around the complete body, around 10% at all sides. Do not merely stretch or crop the old pixels; preserve natural proportions of the copper plates in the redrawing. Keep a gently pointed boat-like left end and covered right end; ONE object, no duplicated modules. No extra decoration, no shiny gold trim, no text, ports, wires, grids, symbols, glow, smoke, background or external shadow. True alpha transparency. Final production export is 256 x 128.
